errors.text_span: 水平轴，标签为“诗歌标题”及“注释”，以字母顺序排列。垂直轴，标签为“难度值”单位为“五言古诗”，刻度从 5.0 到 7.5 以 0.5 的间隔显示，显示数值范围是 5.0 到 7.5。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the horizontal and vertical axes. The horizontal axis represents the difficulty score (values from 5.0 to 7.5), while the vertical axis lists the poem titles.

errors.text_span: 标签为“诗歌标题”及“注释”
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis has no label in the chart. The description hallucinates the labels '诗歌标题' (Poem Title) and '注释' (Annotation).
The chart is not sorted alphabetically. The poems are sorted by their difficulty score in ascending order from top to bottom.
The vertical axis is not labeled '难度值' (Difficulty Value); it simply lists the poem titles and their types.
'五言古诗' (five-character ancient-style poem) is a category of poem listed on the vertical axis, not a unit for the difficulty score.

errors.text_span: 图表由六个柱状图组成
errors.evidence: The chart contains ten bars, not six. It shows the top ten most difficult poems.

errors.text_span: 分别对应《唐诗三百首》的以下诗歌：《唐诗三百首》、白居易《白头吟》、李杜歌、五言古诗、杜甫诗歌、杜牧诗歌
errors.evidence: The description lists completely incorrect poem titles. None of these names appear as categories on the chart's vertical axis.

errors.text_span: 所有柱状图除最右侧的《高适辞题别校五声》柱状图外都显示为浅蓝色。最右侧的柱状图略暗，呈现阴影效果
errors.evidence: This statement is entirely incorrect. All bars are the same light blue color, and there are no shadow effects or visual emphasis on any bar. The poem title '《高适辞题别校五声》' is also hallucinated and not present in the chart.

The description incorrectly attributes the value 6.441976696 to the 'rightmost' (i.e., longest) bar. The longest bar has a value of 7.191943044. The value 6.441976696 corresponds to the fifth bar from the bottom.

errors.text_span: 图表没有按照特定方式进行排序
errors.evidence: This is false. The chart is clearly sorted by the difficulty score in ascending order, from the lowest score at the top to the highest at the bottom.
